description: Allow install-skills.ps1 to update existing PowerShell profile functions instead of skipping them

userStories.title: Detect outdated Ralph functions in profile
userStories.description: When Ralph functions already exist in the PowerShell profile, compare them against the current version to determine if they need updating.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse existing Ralph functions block from profile
Compare function definitions with current expected definitions
Return a status indicating: up-to-date, outdated, or missing functions

userStories.title: Prompt user for update action
userStories.description: When existing functions are detected, prompt the user with options: skip, update, or remove and reinstall.
acceptanceCriteria: Show current vs expected function count
Display which functions are missing or outdated
Update modifies only the Ralph functions block in-place
Reinstall removes old block and appends fresh one

userStories.title: Implement in-place profile update
userStories.description: Replace the existing Ralph functions block in the profile with the updated version while preserving other profile content.
acceptanceCriteria: Find end of block (next comment marker or end of consecutive function lines)
Replace only the Ralph block, preserving everything else
Handle edge cases: block at start, middle, or end of file
Preserve file encoding and line endings

userStories.title: Add --force and --check flags
userStories.description: Add command-line parameters to support non-interactive usage.
acceptanceCriteria: -Check flag only reports status without making changes

userStories.title: Update bash install-skills.sh for parity
userStories.description: Apply the same update logic to the bash version of the installer.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement in-place update preserving other content
